description.value: Prestige Inn Nelson is a full-service hotel on Front Street in Nelson, part of a family-owned British Columbia chain of 19 properties spanning the province from the Kootenays to Vancouver Island. Nelson sits at the heart of the Kootenay Rockies cycling region, making this a natural base for touring cyclists passing through or staging multi-day rides. The property is explicitly dog-friendly and offers a loyalty rewards program for repeat stays.
